'''Faz''' was one of the original 13 planets of the [[Duskhan League]], and was one of the many colony worlds held by the [[Yevetha]]. It was located in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]], in the [[Farlax sector/Legends|Farlax sector]].
